svg.title: J3 Quick entry: speak or type "Sunita 500 udhaar", the form fills, the owner saves

g.text: J3 Quick entry: speak or type "Sunita 500 udhaar", the form fills, the owner saves
setupVoice() at init: the mic button (#quick-mic) is shown only when
SpeechRecognition or webkitSpeechRecognition exists; otherwise only typing
language-not-supported: tried once more in en-IN
[v1.2.4: onend with no words and no error]
v1.2.4: every failure line is followed by a tip.
Phone or tablet (user agent Android, iPhone, iPad, iPod):
quickKeyTip, the microphone key of the keyboard.
Anything else, a touch-screen laptop too:
quickPcTip, Windows key and H (on a Mac, the microphone key).
v1.2: in the nine languages from langs.js, that language's
credit and payment words are taught to the parser (H.quickWords)
Hindi and Telugu digits become 0-9; ₹ and Rs dropped; 1,500 and 5k read as numbers
first number = amount; hazaar, sau, lakh, thousand, hundred multiply it
payment words (paid, jama, mila, upi, gpay...) win over credit words (udhaar, diya, baki...)
name score per customer: exact word 3, prefix 2, one letter off 1,
full phone 10, last four digits 4; English, Hindi and Telugu forms of each name
words that are not names go to the note
[several customers tie for the best score]
